title: From Digital Health Concepts to Implementation Questions in Zurich
summary: Park's summer school reflection follows teams from coaching conversations to their final project pitches.

sources.label: Read Chorong Park's original LinkedIn post

paragraphs.text: After the second UMZH Precision Digital Therapeutics Summer School in Zurich, Chorong Park reflected on coaching participants in the hypertension challenge. Her August 24, 2026, post follows the earlier announcement of her role with a record of the experience.

Park described working with teams as they developed ideas, responded to feedback, and prepared final pitches. The summer school's official program combined group development with coaching and presentations to a panel.

The learning extended beyond designing an interface or building a prototype. Park highlighted the need to think about behavior change, evaluation, practical implementation, and the conditions that allow a digital health idea to be used responsibly.

These were developing concepts, not announcements of approved treatments or proven clinical results. Her reflection emphasized connecting promising ideas to evidence and real-world care before making claims about their impact.

Park thanked Tobias Kowatsch, the organizers, fellow coaches, and participants for the exchange. She described bringing those lessons back to Houston, with renewed attention to responsible development and implementation.
The complete 20-image gallery records coaching sessions, presentations, group photographs, and moments around Zurich. It preserves the broader experience alongside the project work.
